summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 62 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: SpaceX Swings to a Profit, as A.I. Business Grows
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 65 articles published in the last 24 hours
